glosses: floor (the interior bottom or surface of a house or building; the supporting surface of a room)
floor (the bottom surface of a natural structure, entity, or space)

examples.en: The floor has to be scrubbed.
The floor had a good shine.

examples.text: Y a-t-il quelque chose sur le plancher ?
examples.en: Is there anything on the floor?

examples.text: Il s'est allongé sur le plancher.
examples.en: He laid himself flat on the floor.

examples.text: Le plancher craque un peu quand on marche dessus.
examples.en: The floorboards creak a bit when you walk across them.
